# cua-cursor-motion

`src/` of [`@trycua/cursor-motion`](https://github.com/trycua/cua/tree/main/libs/typescript/cursor-motion)
(MIT, see `LICENSE`), copied unchanged from trycua/cua at commit `b803be65c66a` (2026-10-15).
The package is not published to npm; copying `src/` is its documented way of use.
Gugu draws the agent's cursor over a session's browser tab with it (#7191, `agent-browser-cursor.tsx`).
To update: copy `libs/typescript/cursor-motion/src/*.ts` again and bump the commit above.
